QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults to off. ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is also off by default (`mbedtls_config.h:2196`)."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says both are off by default but hedges that this is likely a commented-out `#define` to "confirm against the header". It never states that the shipped header leaves both macros undefined, so a default build defines neither.
